**Finding: deviation (Section 6.1 — Exclusivity)**

- **What's wrong:** Section 6.1 bars the Company from participating in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products "during the term of this Agreement." Under Section 4.1 that term auto-renews annually with no outside date, and the only exit (90 days' notice) triggers a Termination Payment under Section 4.2(a). Section 1.6's termination right is pre-launch only, so there is no performance-based release once the Site is live — effectively exclusive dealing for the full term, which is walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Not flagged:** Section 6.3 (HDI's reciprocal non-compete for the term plus two years) and Section 5.2 (our exclusive editorial control) benefit us and are left intact.
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** exclusivity narrowed to twelve months from the Effective Date and made to terminate automatically, without penalty or Termination Payment, on any HDI service level, availability or delivery-date failure. Fallback rather than outright deletion is proportionate given HDI bears all build and hosting costs and gives the reciprocal Section 6.3 covenant.
